关键词: Results of Operations and Financial Condition
主要内容: Waters Corporation, a U.S.-based company, released its financial results for the quarter and year ended December 31, 2015, on January 26, 2016. The report, filed as Form 8-K with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, included a press release attached as Exhibit 99.1. The press release detailed the company's financial performance for the specified periods. The report was signed by Eugene G. Cassis, Corporate Vice President and Chief Financial Officer, on January 26, 2016. The filing was intended to satisfy the company's reporting obligations under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934.
